description: Električne polnilnice Brežice is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA BREŽICE. Electric charging stations Brežice - charging stations offer all owners of electric vehicles who visit the municipality of Brežice the opportunity to charge their electric steel hobbies at as many as 15 locations. Coverage: OBČINA BREŽICE. The portal shows the English title as "Electric charging stations Brežice" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA BREŽICE. Its keywords include električne polnilnice, brežice. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLSX, CSV, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
